[SWS_CM_11365] Execution Context for finding service with handler registration using Instance Specifier
⌈
For the StartFindService method de-
scribed in [SWS_CM_00623] a second overload with an additional input parameter
shall be provided. This parameter shall provide an executioner object in which any
asynchronous computation spawn by StartFindService shall be invoked. The min-
imum behavior of the Execution Context is defined in [SWS_CM_11364].
template<typename ExecutorT>
static ara::core::Result<ara::com::FindServiceHandle> StartFindService(
ara::com::FindServiceHandler<<ProxyClassName>::HandleType> handler,
ara::com::InstanceSpecifier instance, ExecutorT&& executor);
For the first overload without an execution context argument an implementation defined
default execution context (like in previous AUTOSAR releases) shall be used.
⌋
